messages:
Maya: quick heads-up: v0.23 cutoff in ~24h. doing a quick corridor sweep — checklist below. please confirm owner + any known blockers.
Rahul: on it. I'll take the version bump and tag. plan to run the bump script after docs PR merges.
Sam: QA owner here. running a short smoke pass tonight. any specific regressions to look at?
Olivia: docs review done except release notes. @Maya can you paste the high-level bullets for the changelog?
Maya: high-level bullets: improve batching and fix kv-cache eviction bug; minor API clarification for /generate timeout param; docs updated; performance tweaks for quantized kernels.
Rahul: tagging plan: after merge run: `./scripts/bump_version.sh 0.23.0 && git push --tags` will cut rc1. will call out in #eng-releases when tag pushed.
Sam: QA checklist: smoke on staging, integration tests on dedicated, confirm latency SLOs with canary traffic. I'll post results in this thread.
Olivia: changelog snippet for PR: `- Kernels: quantized execution performance improvements
- KV cache: fix eviction causing token order issues
- API: clarify timeout param for /generate (backward-compatible)` — will paste full text later.
Maya: security: did we get a final signoff from the security scan?
security-bot: vulnerability-scan finished: 2 low findings in dev-deps (CID: C-1032, C-1099). No runtime CVEs. Details: https://scans.example.com/3857
Rahul: I'll handle the dev-deps cleanup tomorrow morning. Not blocking RC.
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary-0.23-rc1 at 2026-03-18T02:00Z. Monitor: /deploys/canary/385720
Sam: quick heads-up: failing integration test in redis connector intermittent — logged issue #1429 and pinged triage team.
Maya: @Sam thanks — include the test logs here. If it persists after retry, we'll exclude from smoke and mark for post-cutover fix.
Sam: logs: ```ERR: redis conn timeout at 1201ms
stack: redis/client.go:213 -> session.go:87``` will attach to the issue and PR.
Olivia: docs: I have the release notes draft, need one more infra bullet about routing fallback behavior.
Rahul: infra update: fallback to lower-capacity model variant when burst is full — added note to infra PR.
Maya: OK final asks: - Rahul: tag + push - Olivia: publish release notes - Sam: post smoke results - Rahul/Security: clear low dev-deps or add exception - I'll coordinate cutoff and send final GO/NO-GO 2h before window.
Sam: sounds good. Will ping when smoke done. :thumbsup: 
Rahul: Tagging after docs PR merged, ETA +3h. If merge delayed, will hold and ping.
Maya: thanks all. If you can't make your task, @here say so now. Otherwise I'll send cutoff reminder 2h before.
Olivia: got it, will post notes and link to Console docs.
deploy-bot: Reminder: freeze window begins 2026-03-18T04:00Z. Locking branch: release/v0.23
Maya: last: anyone doing late cherry-picks? please call them out now.
Sam: none from QA side.
Rahul: one small patch for perf test fixture, will cherry-pick to release/v0.23 and include changelog entry.
Maya: cool — keep it small. I'll update owners doc. Thanks all.
security-bot: Security note: re-scan scheduled post-cutoff; please avoid dev-dep upgrades between cutoff and release.
